name: NTREX-128 Test — All Pairs
description: Multi-way parallel evaluation corpus from NTREX-128. 103 languages, 1997 sentences each, all sentence-aligned. Source sentences from WMT19 English news test set, professionally translated into all target languages. HIGH contamination — scores should be used for relative comparison only, not absolute quality claims.

segments.name: Test
segments.purpose: MT evaluation — one-directional from English source

download.instructions: Fetch per-language reference files at the pinned commit via https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MicrosoftTranslator/NTREX/{revision}/NTREX-128/newstest2019-ref.{lang}.txt (one sentence per line). The pin makes every fetch byte-stable; no clone needed.

source.citation: Federmann et al. (2022). NTREX-128 — News Test References for MT Evaluation of 128 Languages.

license.aiTraining: Permitted with attribution under CC-BY-SA-4.0 terms.

contamination.reasoning: Based on WMT19 English news test set (publicly available since 2019). Less commonly used than FLORES+ but still a public benchmark. Source sentences from WMT may appear in training data; translations are less likely to be contaminated.
